title: GTA 6's Official First Update Is Great News For Fans
summary: Even GTA 6 fans who already preloaded the game have more files to download now

News GTA 6 isn’t out yet, but Rockstar’s already patching the game ahead of release day GTA 6's official first update is great news for fans Image: Rockstar Games Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover Sign in to your Polygon.com account Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread 1 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Hopefully you've still got room on your hard drive after preloading the hefty Grand Theft Auto 6 in anticipation of its impending release day. You've got at least one more thing you need to download if you want to enjoy Rockstar's open-world game the moment it goes live on Nov. 19, though. Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover Some GTA 6 fans woke up on Friday morning to a notification about an update for the 1.002 version of the game . The file is one gigabyte, and Rockstar hasn't shared any specific patch notes. The game isn't out yet, so patch notes could be spoilers. Most fans assume the download is the game's day-one patch, which typically contains last-minute fixes that couldn't be implemented in the version shipped with the game. Though many games receive updates before officially releasing, Rockstar's early deployment is still notable. The new version of the game appears to be a staggered update, so not all GTA 6 fans will see it right away. By doling out the update in batches, however, Rockstar increases the chances that launch day will go smoothly. GTA 6 is breaking pre-order records and selling so well that even Rockstar's parent company, Take-Two, has expressed surprise . The downside of having spectacular sales like that, though, is that an unprecedented number of people will all be trying to download and access GTA 6 at once. Rockstar must be preparing for the onslaught behind the scenes. Major games with huge budgets often see problems on launch day due to heavy traffic. A staggered deployment will let GTA 6 's servers breathe a little easier. This is especially welcome given that Xbox online services have been unreliable over the last week due to widespread server issues affecting many Microsoft online products. Will there be more GTA 6 updates before release? This may not be the last update GTA 6 players have to install before Nov. 19. Sony has spent the last couple of months in a game of cat-and-mouse against hackers who are jailbreaking their consoles in the hopes of pirating GTA 6 . The PS5 has since seen an unusual number of patches hitting the platform, seemingly in an effort to combat these tactics. Make sure to check that you've got everything you need downloaded before next Thursday.
